data.one_liner: Discontinued Flutter plugin for building settings screens with pluggable storage.
data.what_it_does: Provides a collection of settings tiles, screens, and modal widgets to quickly construct settings pages. Features a pluggable cache provider interface with default shared preferences support.
use_when: You are maintaining an existing legacy app that already relies on this discontinued package.
avoid_when: Starting a new project, as the package is explicitly discontinued and recommends using 'settings_ui' instead.
You need modern, actively maintained settings screen components.
strengths: Pluggable storage layer allowing custom cache providers like Hive or SharedPreferences.
Comes with a rich set of built-in settings tiles (checkbox, switch, dropdown, radio, slider, color picker, etc.).
Supports conditional visibility of settings based on other inputs.
weaknesses: Recommends migrating to another package (settings_ui) for UI components.
data.setup_notes: Must initialize the plugin with Settings.init() before navigating to the settings page.

alternatives.name: shared_preferences
alternatives.why_pick_it: Recommended for handling the underlying storage layer when migrating away from this package.
